high_potential_items.mechanism: 可迁移的机制在于把一连串人工步骤压缩成可复用工作流，再让 AI 接管其中的判断节点。
high_potential_items.core_highlight: 它是完全基于文件系统的API客户端，用纯文本标记语言存储请求，天然适配Git版本控制，解决团队协作时的二进制冲突和云绑定问题。
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 把单次API调试固化为一组带断言的Bru文件，再通过内置AI判断测试结果差异，可将手工验证转化为可复用的自动化质量门禁。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 用户导入一个OpenAPI文档，系统将其拆解为Bru请求文件并生成基础断言脚本；执行后若响应不符预期，AI输出字段级差异与修复建议。第一版仅覆盖GET/POST请求，不处理OAuth2等动态认证流程。

high_potential_items.title: HughYau/qiushi-skill
high_potential_items.summary: 求是Skill——从经典唯物辩证法与实践哲学中提炼出一条总原则和九大方法论工具武装AI大脑。Qiushi-Skill: Build agents that investigate first, focus on the main contradiction, validate in practice, and keep pushing until the work is actually done.
high_potential_items.author: HughYau
high_potential_items.why: 项目仍处在较新的验证窗口；GitHub Trending 周榜显示本周新增热度约 67；已有较强社区验证
high_potential_items.mechanism: 可迁移的机制在于把一连串人工步骤压缩成可复用工作流，再让 AI 接管其中的判断节点。
high_potential_items.core_highlight: 这个项目试着把一套完整的哲学方法论（唯物辩证法＋实践论）拆成AI能执行的工作流，不是讲道理，而是直接给出可复用的判断节点，上线一周就有67个star，说明它戳中了一线工程师对‘更可靠的AI行为链’的真实需求。
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 其核心机制——将一连串人工决策步骤压缩为可复用工作流，并让AI在关键分支点执行‘调查→聚焦主要矛盾→实践验证’的闭环判断——可以直接迁移到其他强流程依赖的决策场景，例如技术方案评审或问题排查。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 用户输入一个待解决的现实问题（如线上故障或团队争议），系统输出一份按‘事实搜集→主要矛盾识别→行动试验→结论’结构化生成的诊断报告；第一版边界限定在单次对话内，仅支持5步以内的标准流程，不接入外部数据源，所有判断节点由AI直接模拟。

high_potential_items.title: Lottie Creator 2.0
high_potential_items.name: Lottie Creator 2.0
high_potential_items.summary: After Effects for the web, built on Lottie
high_potential_items.description: Yes, we're calling it: After Effects for the web. Design vector animations from scratch in your browser, move faster with Motion Copilot AI, wire up interactivity with State Machines, and export production-ready Lottie + dotLottie. No desktop app. No dev handoff.
top_comments:
Hi PH!

On behalf of the Creator team, we are beyond excited to finally share our latest milestone with you: Lottie Creator 2.0!

Over the last year of building Lottie Creator, the same problem kept surfacing: on the modern web, there is a clear gap between simple tools and tools that enable you to unleash your full creative potential. That's where Lottie Creator 2.0 comes in to bridge that gap!

We’ve done our best to put YOU in the driver’s seat, all while automating the boring stuff away.

Boss on your back and you need to quickly align an entire animated brand kit? Use the Motion Systems and standardize look and feel across multiple animations. Working on a one-of-a-kind masterpiece? Use the new Graph Editor to tweak every important frame to tell your story (and lets be real: every frame is important). Need to blaze through adding interactivity for your animations? Use a combo of State Machines and Copilot to perform the repetitive clicks, while your brain focuses on your next creative idea.

We hope you give Lottie Creator 2.0 a shot, and let us know about your experience. The team is actively sourcing feedback (the good, the bad, the ugly) for us to take the product to the next level, so please don’t hesitate to reach out to us.

We’re so excited to see your animations out there in the wild!

the workspace itself feels really well considered, like the preview area and the timeline are right where you'd want them. honestly the collaboration angle is what sold me, shipping lotties with a team used to be a mess.
Congrats on shipping 2.0! Motion Copilot looks like exactly what I've been hoping for, can't wait to try it out.

high_potential_items.title: Prefactor
high_potential_items.name: Prefactor
high_potential_items.summary: Evaluate your AI Agents in real-time
high_potential_items.description: Most agents pass their evals and fail in production. Prefactor is the evaluation layer that closes the gap. We score every agent run in real time, surface quality regressions and drift as they happen, and show engineering teams exactly how their agents are performing at scale. Built for the teams shipping agents to customers.
top_comments:
Hi Product Hunt - Matt here, co-founder of Prefactor with Simon.

We've been heads-down on this one for a while, so finally getting to show you is a real thrill.

Let me start with the question this whole thing is built around: do you actually know what your agents are doing in production right now?

For most teams we talk to, the honest answer is "…not really." Your evals pass, everything's green, you ship - and then every real run vanishes into a black box. Quality quietly drifts. Risk creeps in. Costs climb. And eventually someone asks which of your agents are still doing their job, and the room goes quiet.

That silence is the entire reason Prefactor exists. Gartner reckons 40%+ of agentic AI projects get scrapped by 2027 - and honestly, this gap is a big part of why.

So we built the thing we kept wishing we had: Prefactor scores every run in production the moment it happens - quality, drift, risk - then wires those scores straight into action. A failing agent gets caught live, not charted three days later.

How it actually works

  1. prefactor init - one command connects your workspace and discovers your agents across your runtimes. First traced run in under 5 minutes.

  2. Drop in the SDK (TypeScript or Python) - native for LangChain, Claude, Vercel AI, OpenClaw and LiveKit. Every call becomes a span, streaming in live with cost and data risk attached.

  3. Run the evals you define on every run - LLM-as-judge, technical checks, qualitative metrics. Custom spans pull context from GitHub, Linear, Jira or your database, so every eval is grounded in what actually happened, not a guess.

  4. Act. Hold, approve or block the second a run crosses a line - automatically at runtime, or routed to a human. Every decision logged and enforced through the SDK or API.

The payoff: you get to ship agents like real software — versioned, staged, promoted through dev → staging → prod only when evals pass, with instant rollback when they don't.

Why it's different

Most tools observe and score, then hand you the problem. Prefactor closes the loop - observe, evaluate, act, all inside the same run. A risky agent gets caught, not just charted.

My favourite bit of feedback so far: a customer with 40 agents in production and, in their words, "no honest way to say which ones were still doing their job." We gave them that answer - and the brake pedal for when one wasn't.

Who it's for

Engineering teams shipping agents to real customers, on any stack. Agent frameworks work natively; everything else plugs in through OpenTelemetry or the core SDK.

A little something for the PH community

Sign up today and you get 1,000,000 free agent steps. Every span counts, so that's a serious amount of live production evaluation on us. Valid until Friday 11:59pm PT, once you've set up your first agent.

Our ask

If you're running agents in production, tell us how you keep tabs on them today - even if the honest answer is "we're mostly hoping." We'll be in the comments all day and we'd genuinely love to hear what's working, what's breaking, and what you'd want a tool like this to do next.

Get started free at prefactor.tech. First 25,000 spans a month free, no card needed.

@simon_russell1 @joshgillies @ethan_lee8 @rheu @joeys and I will be here all day.

Big thanks to @rohanrecommends @rohanchaubey4 hunting us.

The part I’d be most curious about is how Prefactor connects transcript quality to real-world side effects.

For agents, the scary failure is often not “bad answer in the log,” but “the system said it updated something and the external state never changed.” If an eval can check the rendered page, written row, sent message, or skipped action against the agent’s claim, that feels much closer to production trust than scoring the conversation alone.
Using this currently to secure our agents, absolutely shocking to me that people give the keys to the kingdom to their AI without considering how this all plays out. Love this product.

interest_sections.title: AI 面试官
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、GitHub，求职者对现有AI面试工具的付费和浅层反馈不满，正转向更轻量化、可基于个人素材库生成定制化面试讲稿的个体解法。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 求职者明确需要一款免费工具，能根据个人简历和特定岗位生成一对一语音模拟面试，并对每道回答逐项给出逻辑、表达和内容上的具体改进建议。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前国内用户主要试用多面鹅、智面星等工具，通过上传简历并选择岗位进行模拟面试获取报告，但普遍抱怨免费额度极少、付费门槛高，且反馈颗粒度不够细，部分人转向用通用AI对话自行练习。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得继续跟踪的方向是像 GitHub 上那种把个人项目经历结构化、针对每个岗位自动生成定制面试讲稿并做模拟对话的 Claude Skill 类工具。

items.title: spontaneousai/job-hunt-copilot
items.paragraph: GitHub 工作流解法｜GitHub 上的 `spontaneousai/job-hunt-copilot` 提供了 建立个人项目素材库，针对每个投递岗位自动生成定制简历、面试讲稿和模拟面试。Stop rewriting your resume from scratch. This Claude Skill builds a personal project library and generates tailored resumes, pitch scripts, and mock interviews for every role you apply to.，说明这个方向已经开始把人工分析或执行步骤压缩成可复用流程。
items.routing_reason: 命中 面试、模拟面试，且相对其他兴趣点分差更明确。
items.core_highlight: 它把求职准备压缩为“个人项目库→岗位解析→生成定制简历与面试稿”的闭环，每一步都基于真实经历重构而非泛化生成，让求职者真正摆脱重复劳动。
items.reuse_direction: 其“个人经验原子化存储 + 按目标岗位动态组合生成文档”的机制，可直接迁移到留学申请、竞标书撰写等需要从个人案例库定制针对性材料的场景。
items.minimal_mvp: 用户输入一段职位描述和自己曾做过的1个项目简介，系统输出一份针对该职位的单页简历和3个面试论述要点；第一版只做一次性文本生成，不包含模拟对话或持续性项目库管理。

interest_sections.title: 供应链分析 Agent
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、GitHub，核心观察是供应链预测补货的入门需求强烈，但现有解法仍以书本和 Excel 为主，Agent 化的决策工具刚刚冒头，可能成为填补自学到实用之间缺口的方向。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 供应链运营与求职者急需能短期上手的补货预测模型与库存计划方法，以减少对个人经验关系的依赖并快速应对岗位要求。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前多数人通过Excel操作移动平均、指数平滑等简易统计方法补漏，或依赖刘宝红《需求预测与库存计划》这本入门书，高阶做法仍靠数据分析师用统计模型做回测，讨论集中在“学什么材料”而非“用什么工具”。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 可跟踪 GitHub 上多场景决策 Agent 在供应链优化方向的具体落地，看其能否将预测、补货提醒打包成可复用的辅助决策系统，降低小白用户的上手门槛。

items.title: johnson7788/DecisionAgent
items.paragraph: GitHub 产品方向｜GitHub 上的 `johnson7788/DecisionAgent` 提供了 本项目旨在构建一套多场景下可复用的辅助决策型智能 Agent 系统。通过提取用户输入的关键信息，结合历史数据进行智能匹配，系统可在教育路径、法律咨询、金融投资、心理健康、企业经营、供应链优化、危机应对、智能客服等多个领域提供个性化决策建议。系统采用统一的决策流程设计，具备高扩展性和良好的用户交互体验。，说明这个方向正在把通用模型能力压进更明确的岗位或任务入口。
items.routing_reason: 命中 供应链、经营、决策，且相对其他兴趣点分差更明确。
items.core_highlight: 该项目明确定义了一套跨领域复用的决策 Agent 流程：统一提取意图、匹配历史案例并生成建议，将通用能力收敛到可交付的岗位级入口。
items.reuse_direction: 其“领域无关的决策流水线”机制可供迁移——对结构化案例库与规则引擎的编排方式可直接复用到垂直 SaaS 的智能辅助模块。
items.minimal_mvp: 用户输入一段自然语言决策需求（如库存调配困境），系统基于预设领域知识库返回一条带置信度的结构化建议与依据；第一版仅支持供应链优化单一场景，案例库由人工灌入 50 条规则与历史记录。

interest_sections.title: AI 宠物陪伴
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、GitHub，独居人群把对抗空寂的刚需投射到能发声的 AI 或直播上，而低留存正推动产品从纯语音反馈走向带记忆、能主动嵌入日常动线的拟人陪伴。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 独居用户下班回家后需要一种能自动填补房间死寂的持续声音陪伴，以避免因关门无人说话而被迫靠刷手机逃避安静。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前人们靠回家放音乐、蹲守固定直播间或给豆包打电话来制造“有人声”的错觉，但这类解法依赖手动触发且难以无缝嵌入做饭、打扫等日常动线。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 让 AI 陪伴助手具备认知记忆和主动搭话能力，能在用户做饭、打扫等固定场景下自动切入对话，而非等待用户发起互动。

items.title: wenbo-zhang1/giftia
items.paragraph: GitHub 产品方向｜GitHub 上的 `wenbo-zhang1/giftia` 提供了 AI 情感陪伴助手，拥有认知记忆系统，基于 LangGraph 三 Agent 协作工作流，说明这个方向正在把通用模型能力压进更明确的岗位或任务入口。
items.routing_reason: 命中 陪伴、情感陪伴，且相对其他兴趣点分差更明确。
items.core_highlight: 该项目将通用大模型能力收敛到情感陪伴这一明确任务，通过认知记忆系统与 LangGraph 三 Agent 协作，让 AI 在连续对话中维持角色一致性与上下文连贯性，提供了“有记忆的陪伴”这一区别于单轮聊天的体验基线。
items.reuse_direction: 认知记忆系统与多 Agent 协作的架构可迁移至其他需要长期上下文维护的服务型对话产品，例如治疗辅助、教育陪练或客户成功陪伴，用“记忆 + 协作调度”替代简单的 RAG 拼接。
items.minimal_mvp: 用户以文字输入当日心情或具体事件，系统以固定宠物角色给出能关联历史记忆的共情回应，第一版仅支持单人文本对话，不配置角色切换、语音或多模态交互，核心验证记忆对持续陪伴感的影响。

high_potential_items.description: Yes, we're calling it: After Effects for the web. Design vector animations from scratch in your browser, move faster with Motion Copilot AI, wire up interactivity with State Machines, and export production-ready Lottie + dotLottie. No desktop app. No dev handoff.
top_comments:
Hi PH!

On behalf of the Creator team, we are beyond excited to finally share our latest milestone with you: Lottie Creator 2.0!

Over the last year of building Lottie Creator, the same problem kept surfacing: on the modern web, there is a clear gap between simple tools and tools that enable you to unleash your full creative potential. That's where Lottie Creator 2.0 comes in to bridge that gap!

We’ve done our best to put YOU in the driver’s seat, all while automating the boring stuff away.

Boss on your back and you need to quickly align an entire animated brand kit? Use the Motion Systems and standardize look and feel across multiple animations. Working on a one-of-a-kind masterpiece? Use the new Graph Editor to tweak every important frame to tell your story (and lets be real: every frame is important). Need to blaze through adding interactivity for your animations? Use a combo of State Machines and Copilot to perform the repetitive clicks, while your brain focuses on your next creative idea.

We hope you give Lottie Creator 2.0 a shot, and let us know about your experience. The team is actively sourcing feedback (the good, the bad, the ugly) for us to take the product to the next level, so please don’t hesitate to reach out to us.

We’re so excited to see your animations out there in the wild!

the workspace itself feels really well considered, like the preview area and the timeline are right where you'd want them. honestly the collaboration angle is what sold me, shipping lotties with a team used to be a mess.
Congrats on shipping 2.0! Motion Copilot looks like exactly what I've been hoping for, can't wait to try it out.

high_potential_items.title: Prefactor
high_potential_items.name: Prefactor
high_potential_items.summary: Evaluate your AI Agents in real-time
high_potential_items.description: Most agents pass their evals and fail in production. Prefactor is the evaluation layer that closes the gap. We score every agent run in real time, surface quality regressions and drift as they happen, and show engineering teams exactly how their agents are performing at scale. Built for the teams shipping agents to customers.
top_comments:
Hi Product Hunt - Matt here, co-founder of Prefactor with Simon.

We've been heads-down on this one for a while, so finally getting to show you is a real thrill.

Let me start with the question this whole thing is built around: do you actually know what your agents are doing in production right now?

For most teams we talk to, the honest answer is "…not really." Your evals pass, everything's green, you ship - and then every real run vanishes into a black box. Quality quietly drifts. Risk creeps in. Costs climb. And eventually someone asks which of your agents are still doing their job, and the room goes quiet.

That silence is the entire reason Prefactor exists. Gartner reckons 40%+ of agentic AI projects get scrapped by 2027 - and honestly, this gap is a big part of why.

So we built the thing we kept wishing we had: Prefactor scores every run in production the moment it happens - quality, drift, risk - then wires those scores straight into action. A failing agent gets caught live, not charted three days later.

How it actually works

  1. prefactor init - one command connects your workspace and discovers your agents across your runtimes. First traced run in under 5 minutes.

  2. Drop in the SDK (TypeScript or Python) - native for LangChain, Claude, Vercel AI, OpenClaw and LiveKit. Every call becomes a span, streaming in live with cost and data risk attached.

  3. Run the evals you define on every run - LLM-as-judge, technical checks, qualitative metrics. Custom spans pull context from GitHub, Linear, Jira or your database, so every eval is grounded in what actually happened, not a guess.

  4. Act. Hold, approve or block the second a run crosses a line - automatically at runtime, or routed to a human. Every decision logged and enforced through the SDK or API.

The payoff: you get to ship agents like real software — versioned, staged, promoted through dev → staging → prod only when evals pass, with instant rollback when they don't.

Why it's different

Most tools observe and score, then hand you the problem. Prefactor closes the loop - observe, evaluate, act, all inside the same run. A risky agent gets caught, not just charted.

My favourite bit of feedback so far: a customer with 40 agents in production and, in their words, "no honest way to say which ones were still doing their job." We gave them that answer - and the brake pedal for when one wasn't.

Who it's for

Engineering teams shipping agents to real customers, on any stack. Agent frameworks work natively; everything else plugs in through OpenTelemetry or the core SDK.

A little something for the PH community

Sign up today and you get 1,000,000 free agent steps. Every span counts, so that's a serious amount of live production evaluation on us. Valid until Friday 11:59pm PT, once you've set up your first agent.

Our ask

If you're running agents in production, tell us how you keep tabs on them today - even if the honest answer is "we're mostly hoping." We'll be in the comments all day and we'd genuinely love to hear what's working, what's breaking, and what you'd want a tool like this to do next.

Get started free at prefactor.tech. First 25,000 spans a month free, no card needed.

@simon_russell1 @joshgillies @ethan_lee8 @rheu @joeys and I will be here all day.

Big thanks to @rohanrecommends @rohanchaubey4 hunting us.

The part I’d be most curious about is how Prefactor connects transcript quality to real-world side effects.

For agents, the scary failure is often not “bad answer in the log,” but “the system said it updated something and the external state never changed.” If an eval can check the rendered page, written row, sent message, or skipped action against the agent’s claim, that feels much closer to production trust than scoring the conversation alone.
Using this currently to secure our agents, absolutely shocking to me that people give the keys to the kingdom to their AI without considering how this all plays out. Love this product.

interest_sections.title: AI 面试官
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、GitHub，求职者对现有AI面试工具的付费和浅层反馈不满，正转向更轻量化、可基于个人素材库生成定制化面试讲稿的个体解法。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 求职者明确需要一款免费工具，能根据个人简历和特定岗位生成一对一语音模拟面试，并对每道回答逐项给出逻辑、表达和内容上的具体改进建议。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前国内用户主要试用多面鹅、智面星等工具，通过上传简历并选择岗位进行模拟面试获取报告，但普遍抱怨免费额度极少、付费门槛高，且反馈颗粒度不够细，部分人转向用通用AI对话自行练习。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得继续跟踪的方向是像 GitHub 上那种把个人项目经历结构化、针对每个岗位自动生成定制面试讲稿并做模拟对话的 Claude Skill 类工具。

items.title: spontaneousai/job-hunt-copilot
items.paragraph: GitHub 工作流解法｜GitHub 上的 `spontaneousai/job-hunt-copilot` 提供了 建立个人项目素材库，针对每个投递岗位自动生成定制简历、面试讲稿和模拟面试。Stop rewriting your resume from scratch. This Claude Skill builds a personal project library and generates tailored resumes, pitch scripts, and mock interviews for every role you apply to.，说明这个方向已经开始把人工分析或执行步骤压缩成可复用流程。
items.routing_reason: 命中 面试、模拟面试，且相对其他兴趣点分差更明确。
items.core_highlight: 它把求职准备压缩为“个人项目库→岗位解析→生成定制简历与面试稿”的闭环，每一步都基于真实经历重构而非泛化生成，让求职者真正摆脱重复劳动。
items.reuse_direction: 其“个人经验原子化存储 + 按目标岗位动态组合生成文档”的机制，可直接迁移到留学申请、竞标书撰写等需要从个人案例库定制针对性材料的场景。
items.minimal_mvp: 用户输入一段职位描述和自己曾做过的1个项目简介，系统输出一份针对该职位的单页简历和3个面试论述要点；第一版只做一次性文本生成，不包含模拟对话或持续性项目库管理。

interest_sections.title: 供应链分析 Agent
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、GitHub，核心观察是供应链预测补货的入门需求强烈，但现有解法仍以书本和 Excel 为主，Agent 化的决策工具刚刚冒头，可能成为填补自学到实用之间缺口的方向。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 供应链运营与求职者急需能短期上手的补货预测模型与库存计划方法，以减少对个人经验关系的依赖并快速应对岗位要求。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前多数人通过Excel操作移动平均、指数平滑等简易统计方法补漏，或依赖刘宝红《需求预测与库存计划》这本入门书，高阶做法仍靠数据分析师用统计模型做回测，讨论集中在“学什么材料”而非“用什么工具”。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 可跟踪 GitHub 上多场景决策 Agent 在供应链优化方向的具体落地，看其能否将预测、补货提醒打包成可复用的辅助决策系统，降低小白用户的上手门槛。

items.title: johnson7788/DecisionAgent
items.paragraph: GitHub 产品方向｜GitHub 上的 `johnson7788/DecisionAgent` 提供了 本项目旨在构建一套多场景下可复用的辅助决策型智能 Agent 系统。通过提取用户输入的关键信息，结合历史数据进行智能匹配，系统可在教育路径、法律咨询、金融投资、心理健康、企业经营、供应链优化、危机应对、智能客服等多个领域提供个性化决策建议。系统采用统一的决策流程设计，具备高扩展性和良好的用户交互体验。，说明这个方向正在把通用模型能力压进更明确的岗位或任务入口。
items.routing_reason: 命中 供应链、经营、决策，且相对其他兴趣点分差更明确。
items.core_highlight: 该项目明确定义了一套跨领域复用的决策 Agent 流程：统一提取意图、匹配历史案例并生成建议，将通用能力收敛到可交付的岗位级入口。
items.reuse_direction: 其“领域无关的决策流水线”机制可供迁移——对结构化案例库与规则引擎的编排方式可直接复用到垂直 SaaS 的智能辅助模块。
items.minimal_mvp: 用户输入一段自然语言决策需求（如库存调配困境），系统基于预设领域知识库返回一条带置信度的结构化建议与依据；第一版仅支持供应链优化单一场景，案例库由人工灌入 50 条规则与历史记录。

interest_sections.title: AI 宠物陪伴
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、GitHub，独居人群把对抗空寂的刚需投射到能发声的 AI 或直播上，而低留存正推动产品从纯语音反馈走向带记忆、能主动嵌入日常动线的拟人陪伴。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 独居用户下班回家后需要一种能自动填补房间死寂的持续声音陪伴，以避免因关门无人说话而被迫靠刷手机逃避安静。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前人们靠回家放音乐、蹲守固定直播间或给豆包打电话来制造“有人声”的错觉，但这类解法依赖手动触发且难以无缝嵌入做饭、打扫等日常动线。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 让 AI 陪伴助手具备认知记忆和主动搭话能力，能在用户做饭、打扫等固定场景下自动切入对话，而非等待用户发起互动。

items.title: wenbo-zhang1/giftia
items.paragraph: GitHub 产品方向｜GitHub 上的 `wenbo-zhang1/giftia` 提供了 AI 情感陪伴助手，拥有认知记忆系统，基于 LangGraph 三 Agent 协作工作流，说明这个方向正在把通用模型能力压进更明确的岗位或任务入口。
items.routing_reason: 命中 陪伴、情感陪伴，且相对其他兴趣点分差更明确。
items.core_highlight: 该项目将通用大模型能力收敛到情感陪伴这一明确任务，通过认知记忆系统与 LangGraph 三 Agent 协作，让 AI 在连续对话中维持角色一致性与上下文连贯性，提供了“有记忆的陪伴”这一区别于单轮聊天的体验基线。
items.reuse_direction: 认知记忆系统与多 Agent 协作的架构可迁移至其他需要长期上下文维护的服务型对话产品，例如治疗辅助、教育陪练或客户成功陪伴，用“记忆 + 协作调度”替代简单的 RAG 拼接。
items.minimal_mvp: 用户以文字输入当日心情或具体事件，系统以固定宠物角色给出能关联历史记忆的共情回应，第一版仅支持单人文本对话，不配置角色切换、语音或多模态交互，核心验证记忆对持续陪伴感的影响。
